text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- Official results of Macedonia's local elections expected at midnight Wednesday. According to incomplete unofficial results the Social Democratic Alliance (SDAM) has 13 mayors elected in the first round, opposition coalition of the Internal Macedonian Revolutinary Organisation, Democratic Party of Macedonian national Unty and Macedonian Action conservative party (IMRO-DPMNY-DP-MAAK) 10 mayors, The socialist party of Macedonia (SPM) four, the ethnic Albanian Party of Democratic Prosperity (PDP) eight, the radical nationalist Party of Democratic Prosperity of Albanians (PDPA) one mayor, the Democratic Party of Turks one mayor.
- Regarding the number of votes so far the SDAM is in the lead with around 234,000 votes followed by IMRO-DPMNY-DP-MAAK with 225,000 votes and the LP with 73,000 votes.
- Many complaints announced by different parties. The complaints are to be addressed to the municipal election comissions.

- The head of the OSCE observer mission in Macedonia Bernard Owen said that according to reports from 66 observers the voting process was conducted properly in 89 percent of the 566 polling stations observed.
